Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment used a combination of native and tag-mediated (HA) immunoprecipitation (AP-MS) followed by TMT labeling and DDA acquisition on an Orbitrap Velos. While the PRIDE metadata mentions a Q Exactive instrument, the detailed methods text explicitly describes an LTQ Orbitrap Velos.

scope: CHD8 and HA IP were done using Chd8 antibodies (abs) bought from Novus biological (NB100-60417) and Bethyl (A301-224A), HA ab was acquired from Sigma (H6908).
